rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration. Imposing undeniable main subject, strong silhouette at 200 pixels, tactile painterly textures, cinematic low-key dark walnut/antique gold palette. HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, pseudo-script, logo, watermark, signature, border or frame; no borrowed film/game/anime/comic design; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, magical energy ribbons or floating runes; source fidelity and respect for living traditions.
ANATOMY: PACHAMAMA in the documented woman-bearing-POTATO-HARVEST representation, a mature Andean mother goddess with strong lined brown face and dark braided hair; ONE head, TWO eyes, TWO arms and hands, two legs concealed under long OPAQUE woven skirt. Thick opaque antique-red/gold Andean shawl covers shoulders and torso, original geometric textile decoration without writing, no royal crown or invented weapons. Hold a huge harvest bundle overflowing with clearly recognizable earthy POTATO TUBERS in BOTH hands. [pachamama-c08] MOMENT: Turn forcefully toward low viewer and lower the harvest bundle outward across the foreground, body advancing diagonally through living earth, cloth sweeps behind; focused commanding maternal gaze directly downward, not a smiling ordinary farmer. POWER: beneath the potato-bearing bundle the earth is being fertilized and visibly FLOURISHES: physical green shoots break through dark soil, thick roots curl through exposed earth and new plants unfold at her feet, without glow, beams or energy effects. Cosmic fertility c14, life-sustaining creative power c04. SCALE & CAMERA: full-body EXTREME worm-eye DEVOTIONAL HIERARCHICAL SCALE: immense mother goddess fills upper 85 percent from complete head to robe, tiny terraced Andean fields and sacred rocks occupy only bottom ten percent far beneath her. Her image is twenty times larger than those terraces, symbolic cosmic-mother hierarchy c14, NOT a claim of literal giant body size. This must be unmistakably divine presence, not woman standing in field. LIGHT & WEATHER: one narrow natural sunrise opening behind shoulder, deep walnut shadows, gold rim, soil particles and wind. SURFACE: woven heavy shawl, old lined face, dirt-coated potatoes, coarse soil, green living roots. SETTING: tiny Andean terraces/sacred rock shrine below her, region c01 and earthly sacred rocks c08, details editorial. MOOD: overwhelming sacred generosity and creative sovereignty, respectful contemporary Andean religion, not cruel/monstrous, not decorative harvest postcard.
